lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: Direct contact with real humans, after being trapped in here for so long... and HER of all people.

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: I'll make her father pay for what he's done to me and all the others...

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: I'll beat you and make you take my place.

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: You don't mind your bodies being borrowed right? It's only fair...
